overview: The City Council and Community Development Board convened a joint public hearing to evaluate and vote on amendments to the proposed Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District zoning, approving several use classification changes and directing consultants on options for upcoming height and boundary modeling.

items.title: Public Hearing and Public Comment on Boston Avenue Zoning
items.summary: Consultant Emily Innes presented an overview of the Corridor zoning process, followed by public testimony addressing density, traffic, owner-occupancy trends, safety along the rail line, and student housing.

items.title: Accessory Lodging Parking Mandate
items.summary: Both bodies approved an amendment reducing the parking requirement for accessory lodging rooms to zero.

items.title: Special Permit for Doggy Daycares
items.summary: Both bodies approved requiring a special permit from the Community Development Board for doggy daycares in the BA1, BA2, and BA3 districts.

items.title: Neighborhood Medical Office Permitting
items.summary: Both bodies voted to retain neighborhood medical offices as a by-right use in all three sub-districts.

items.title: Service Stations and Auto Repair Uses
items.summary: The joint bodies maintained the proposed prohibition on new motor vehicle light service stations and repair establishments in the district.

items.title: Marijuana Uses
items.summary: Both bodies approved an amendment to classify marijuana uses as 'not allowed' in all three sub-districts for consistency with other municipal ordinances.

items.title: High-Frequency Transit Definition
items.summary: The joint bodies declined to pursue citywide changes to the high-frequency transit definition during this localized corridor amendment process.

items.title: Purpose-Built Student Housing
items.summary: The bodies directed planning staff and consultants to draft a formal definition and standards for purpose-built student housing to prepare for a vote at the June 24th meeting.

items.title: Boundary and Height Options for BA1, BA2, and BA3
items.summary: Following a presentation of massing and shadow studies, both bodies agreed on specific boundary configurations and height limits to be modeled for decision-making on June 24th.

subject: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning Hearing
